Section 1b: Temporal trends
- Is VPD becoming more important in recent years in long-term sites?
- Extreme summer events
- Predictability over time

```{r}
library(zoo)

long_term_sites <- c("How", "Tum", "Wom", "Asm", "Cpr")

vpd_trend <- sites_daily_df %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP, VPD) %>%                   # remove NAs before grouping
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%                   # stricter threshold — 3 is too few for a regression
  summarise(
    R2_annual = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot R² over time per site
ggplot(vpd_trend, aes(x = year, y = R2_annual, colour = site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#4682B4","#F28C28","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annual R² (GPP ~ VPD)", 
       title = "Is VPD becoming more important over time?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Test significance of trend per site
vpd_trend %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope  = coef(lm(R2_annual ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(R2_annual ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )
```
```{r}
vpd_trend_summary <- tibble(
  site    = c("Asm", "Cpr", "How", "Tum", "Wom"),
  slope   = c(0.00975, 0.00571, -0.01857, 0.00419, 0.00290),
  p_value = c(0.061, 0.289, 0.014, 0.629, 0.610)
) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = p_value < 0.05,
    label       = paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 3))
  )

ggplot(vpd_trend_summary, aes(x = reorder(site, slope), y = slope, 
                               fill = significant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label,
                hjust = ifelse(slope > 0, -0.1, 1.1)),
            size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4682B4", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "p < 0.05", "FALSE" = "p ≥ 0.05")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.015)) +  # expand range for labels
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Trend in annual R² (GPP ~ VPD)",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Is VPD becoming more important over time?",
       subtitle = "Slope of R² ~ year per long-term site") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5, unit = "pt"))
```

```{r}
# ── Calculate VPD anomalies and flag extremes ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes <- sites_daily_df %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(VPD) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_mean     = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_sd       = sd(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_anomaly  = VPD - vpd_mean,                    # raw anomaly
    vpd_z        = vpd_anomaly / vpd_sd,              # standardised anomaly
    extreme      = vpd_z > 1.5                        # flag extremes (adjust threshold as needed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
vpd_extreme_annual <- vpd_extremes %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_extreme    = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),         # count of extreme days
    prop_extreme = mean(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),        # proportion of days
    mean_anomaly = mean(vpd_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),    # mean annual anomaly
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(vpd_extreme_annual, aes(x = year, y = n_extreme, colour = site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#4682B4","#F28C28","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. extreme VPD days per year",
       title = "Are VPD extremes becoming more frequent?",
       subtitle = "Extreme = VPD > 1.5 SD above site mean") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: Calculate VPD extremes using 95th percentile ─────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, date) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_mean    = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_anomaly = VPD - vpd_mean,
    vpd_p95     = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme     = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Q1: Are VPD anomalies increasing in frequency? ───────────────────────────
vpd_annual_extremes <- vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(n_extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(vpd_annual_extremes %>% filter(site %in% long_term_sites),
       aes(x = year, y = n_extreme)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. days above 95th percentile",
       title = "Are extreme VPD events becoming more frequent?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# significance
vpd_annual_extremes %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope   = coef(lm(n_extreme ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(n_extreme ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )

# ── Q2: Are VPD anomalies increasing in magnitude? ───────────────────────────
vpd_annual_anom <- vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(extreme) %>%                           # only look at extreme days
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_extreme_vpd = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(vpd_annual_anom %>% filter(site %in% long_term_sites),
       aes(x = year, y = mean_extreme_vpd)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean VPD on extreme days (kPa)",
       title = "Are VPD extremes becoming more intense?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Q3: Do extremes coincide with low precipitation? ─────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(Precip) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = Precip, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily Precipitation (mm)",
       title = "Do extreme VPD days coincide with low precipitation?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Q4: Do extremes coincide with low GPP? ───────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP",
       title = "Do extreme VPD days coincide with low GPP?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Summary statistics for Q3 and Q4 ─────────────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP, Precip) %>%
  group_by(site, extreme) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_GPP    = mean(GPP,    na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Precip = mean(Precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(extreme = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme", "Normal")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = extreme,
              values_from = c(mean_GPP, mean_Precip))
```
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Filter to austral summer and calculate extremes ───────────────────
vpd_summer <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP, date) %>%
  mutate(
    year  = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(month %in% c(12, 1, 2)) %>%           # austral summer only
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_p95     = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),  # summer-specific 95th
    extreme     = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Step 2: GPP ~ VPD sensitivity per site per year (summer only) ─────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer <- vpd_summer %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%
  summarise(
    vpd_slope = coef(lm(GPP ~ VPD))[2],
    R2        = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: Plot sensitivity trend over time — long-term sites ────────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = vpd_slope)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#F28C28", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP ~ VPD slope (summer)",
       title = "Is summer GPP sensitivity to VPD changing over time?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Step 4: Significance of sensitivity trend ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope   = coef(lm(vpd_slope ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(vpd_slope ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )

# ── Step 5: Extreme VPD days in summer — frequency trend ─────────────────────
vpd_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(n_extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_extreme)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. extreme VPD days (summer)",
       title = "Are summer VPD extremes becoming more frequent?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Step 6: Do summer extremes suppress GPP? ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP",
       title = "Do summer VPD extremes suppress GPP?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Seasonal GPP ~ VPD sensitivity across all sites ──────────────────
vpd_seasonal <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP, date) %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Autumn",
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring"))
  )

# ── Step 2: GPP ~ VPD slope per site per season ───────────────────────────────
seasonal_sensitivity <- vpd_seasonal %>%
  group_by(site, season) %>%
  filter(n() >= 30) %>%
  summarise(
    vpd_slope = coef(lm(GPP ~ VPD))[2],
    R2        = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: Plot seasonal sensitivity across sites ────────────────────────────
# Order sites by wet to dry or LAI
seasonal_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = vpd_slope, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Summer" = "#F28C28",
    "Autumn" = "#c44e52",
    "Winter" = "#4682B4",
    "Spring" = "#2ca02c"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP ~ VPD slope", fill = NULL,
       title = "Seasonal GPP sensitivity to VPD across Australian sites") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── Step 4: R² per season — where does VPD explain most variance? ─────────────
seasonal_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Summer" = "#F28C28",
    "Autumn" = "#c44e52",
    "Winter" = "#4682B4",
    "Spring" = "#2ca02c"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "R² (GPP ~ VPD)", fill = NULL,
       title = "How much variance does VPD explain per season?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── Step 5: Extreme VPD events suppress GPP — summer vs other seasons ─────────
vpd_seasonal %>%
  group_by(site, season) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_p95 = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP", fill = NULL,
       title = "Does extreme VPD suppress GPP, and is summer worst?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
